experiment: E2 — Mood × Self factorial (additive vs multiplicative)

interaction_diagnostic.interpretation: Pure additivity predicts delta_low ≈ delta_high; any non-trivial difference signals interaction.

model_fit_raw.note: Primary test: raw-scale linear regression. Multiplicative ground-truth predicts the interaction term wins on raw scale.

model_fit_log.note: Sanity check: log-scale. Because the true formula is a product of terms, log-additivity is predicted; the interaction term should ROT win here.

note: Predicts ΔAIC < -2 (multiplicative wins) because the forget_score formula multiplies emotion_resistance and self_resistance.
